subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: What live Slack evidence is sufficient before allowing a fix PR for this reaction-specific Socket Mode report?
rationale: Current code proves post-envelope reaction handling, but the reported failure is live envelope absence, and only a maintainer or live Slack diagnostic run can choose the canonical proof path without guessing.

options.title: Request live reaction diagnostics
options.body: Keep this issue open and require redacted current-main Socket Mode reaction envelopes, gateway trace logs, and account metadata before code changes.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode triage
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery cluster only after that report gets reaction-specific logs or raw event evidence.

options.title: Attempt speculative repair
options.body: Queue a fix without live proof, accepting a high chance of changing the wrong boundary or adding unnecessary policy surface.

recommendation.title: Request live reaction diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require redacted current-main Socket Mode reaction envelopes, gateway trace logs, and account metadata before code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the prior Slack system-event routing fix that this report explicitly says did not resolve the live delivery symptom.
